generators.command: node bin/rcf.js build queue > test/build/fixtures/queue.md && node bin/rcf.js build queue --format json > test/build/fixtures/queue.json

node bin/rcf.js audit coverage --format table > test/query/fixtures/coverage.table.txt && node bin/rcf.js audit coverage --format json > test/query/fixtures/coverage.json && node bin/rcf.js audit coverage --format mermaid > test/query/fixtures/coverage.mmd

node -e "const { readdirSync } = require('node:fs'); const codeNode = readdirSync('rcf/code-nodes', { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true }).filter((e) => e.isFile() && e.name.endsWith('.json')).length; process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ codeNode }, null, 2) + '\n');" > test/fixtures/code-node-count.json
